name: validate_plan_blueprint
description: 加载并校验指定计划蓝图，检查核心字段完整性、阶段定义有效性与基础可执行性，并输出审计记录。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"planId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"计划ID"},"planVersion":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"可选版本号；不传则加载最新版本"}},"required":["planId"]}
outputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"status":{"type":"string","description":"执行状态"},"data":{"type":"object","description":"蓝图内容与来源信息"},"message":{"type":"string","description":"补充说明"}}}
thoughtChain: 执行结构与关键字段校验
记录校验审计并按需推送事件
